about: The sky in the world (issue #520). Yuno: 240 white puffs (sky type 1) round the player, below the city's edge, fading in together after arriving. Einbroch: 320 #FCAB8F smog puffs 20-24 above the ground. Dali: 260 twinkling stars. Prontera, not in MapSkyData, has none. @clouds on prontera builds 160 type-2 puffs in the world, not over the screen.
